scenario.summary: A campaign using trojanized Inno Setup installers delivered via fake software downloads to install various monetization payloads such as proxyware, distributed computing agents, and adware. The campaign utilizes a structured HTTP callback system to track offer installation status and secures persistence through SYSTEM-level scheduled tasks.

hunt.name: Trojanized Inno Installer Staging and Callbacks
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the multi-stage execution and persistence model used by a fake-download campaign. The campaign lures users with cracked software and activators to run Inno Setup-style wrappers. These wrappers stage numbered payloads in the user's temp directory and contact rotating infrastructure to report offer outcomes. Finally, the campaign installs monetization components like proxyware or compute-resource miners, often persistent through SYSTEM-level scheduled tasks. The hunt follows these stages in two phases: first identifying the temporary staging activity and then corroborating it with the network callbacks and persistence mechanisms.

config.rationale: An adversary has delivered monetization payloads using a trojanized Inno Setup installer that stages numbered executables in temporary paths, contacts offer-tracking infrastructure, and establishes persistence via SYSTEM-level scheduled tasks.

config.description: Identify hosts running software packages commonly used as lures for this campaign, such as cracked tools, activators, or game-related executors.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\is-%.tmp\%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/sl5=%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/spawnwnd=%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/firstwnd=%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify processes executing from the Inno temporary directory or using characteristic wrapper arguments like /SL5.
config.expected_signal: Process rows showing the Inno runner staging environment. The parent may be the original lure filename.

primitive_config.label: Inno runner execution patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\is-%.tmp\%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/sl5=%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/spawnwnd=%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/firstwnd=%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
primitive_config.expected: Process rows showing the Inno runner staging environment. The parent may be the original lure filename.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\is-%.tmp\%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY 1 HAVING host_count <= 5 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count processes running from the Inno temp path so rare numbered stages like eld0.exe stand out from legitimate updaters.
config.expected_signal: A binary name seen on very few hosts (e.g., eld1.exe); common installer names are ignored.

primitive_config.label: Prevalence of temporary runner names
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\is-%.tmp\%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY 1 HAVING host_count <= 5 ORDER BY host_count ASC

config.objective: Identify hosts showing Inno Setup runner activity based on temp paths and rare numbered process names.
config.description: Determine whether the process execution and prevalence patterns indicate a trojanized Inno Setup installer session.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict on the staging phase.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of suspicious if rare processes execute from the Inno temp path with /SL5 arguments.
